name: Clone Symbiant Variant Maturation Option
body:
Variant Maturation Options

The following option trades out the benefits of the s-class symbiant’s maturation class feature. They can also be gained as archetypes of the standard symbiant or as major convergences.

Some of the options grant symbiant feats, racial traits, or traits. If you already have something the maturation option grants, you can select another in its place.

Clone symbiants are not naturally born from the hivemind, but gestated and born by other means, usually involving magic or advanced science. Clone symbiants can have unknowable powers given to them before bonding with a host, and they are usually susceptible to energies other than (or sometimes in addition to) fire and sonic.

Symbiant Bond

Clone symbiants bond to hosts like other symbiants, but their potential for random evolutions is greater. Each of the benefits here counts as a racial trait when selecting the innocuous spawn symbiant technique. Their values are listed as (x RP).

Bite (Ex, 2 RP): The symbiant gains a bite attack which deals 1d4 piercing damage on a hit. This is a primary attack, or a secondary attack (made at a –5 penalty) if the symbiant is also wielding manufactured weapons.
Superior Reflexes (Ex, 1 RP): The symbiant gains a +2 bonus on all Reflex saving throws.
Cloned Origin (4 RP): Choose two symbiant racial traits totaling 4 RP. The symbiant grants those traits to its host. At the GM’s discretion, additional racial traits associated with the cloned symbiant’s origin may be available to choose from.
Maturation (Su)

At 5th level, a maturing clone symbiant grants its host the following benefits.

Modified Training: Choose Acrobatics, Climb, Stealth, or Swim. It is a class skill for the symbiant.
Improved Initiative: The symbiant grants Improved Initiative as a bonus feat.
Ability Score Bonus: The symbiant grants its host a +1 enhancement bonus to Wisdom. This stacks with other enhancement bonuses, but only up to +6 total.
Invigorating Bite: After the symbiant’s bite drops a living foe (kills it or drops it to negative hit points), the symbiant infuses its host with vigor. If its host is fatigued, the symbiant removes the fatigue. If exhausted, the host becomes fatigued instead. If neither exhausted nor fatigued, the host gains a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls and a +10 foot enhancement bonus to all modes of movement possessed until the end of the host’s next turn.
Symbiant Affinity: The symbiant gains a +2 enhancement bonus on Acrobatics, Climb, Stealth, and Swim checks.

At 8th level, a maturing symbiant grants its host the following benefits.

Bane Maw: The symbiant’s bite attack gains the bane weapon special ability.
Nimble: The symbiant grants its host a +1 dodge bonus.
Sprouting Tendrils: At the end of each of the symbiant’s turns, it deals savagery damage to any creature it moved past this turn. This can only damage any given creature once per turn.

At 12th level, a maturing symbiant grants its host the following benefits.

Ability Score Bonus: The symbiant grants its host a +2 enhancement bonus to Dexterity. This stacks with other enhancement bonuses, but only up to +6 total.
Physical Improvement: The symbiant gains Signature Skill as a bonus feat for one of its affinity skills that meets the feat’s prerequisites.
Save Bonuses: The symbiant grants its host a +2 bonus on saving throws against poison.
Symbiant Affinity: The symbiant enhancement bonus on Acrobatics, Climb, Stealth, and Swim checks increases to +4.

At 17th level, a maturing symbiant grants its host the following benefits.

Ability Score Bonus: The symbiant grants its host a +2 enhancement bonus to Charisma. This stacks with other enhancement bonuses, but only up to +6 total.
Save Bonuses: The symbiant grants its host a +2 resistance bonus on all saves. This stacks with other resistance bonuses, but only up to +5 total.
Defensive Roll: Once per day, when the symbiant’s host would be reduced to 0 or fewer hit points by damage in combat (from a weapon or other blow, not a spell or special ability), the symbiant can attempt to roll with the damage. To use this ability, the symbiant must attempt a Reflex saving throw (DC = damage dealt). If the save succeeds, its host takes only half damage from the blow; if it fails, they take full damage. The symbiant must be aware of the attack and able to react to it in order to execute its defensive roll—if the symbiant is denied its Dexterity bonus to AC, it can’t use this ability. Since this effect would not normally allow a character to make a Reflex save for half damage, the evasion ability does not apply to the defensive roll.
Symbiant Affinity: The symbiant enhancement bonus on Acrobatics, Climb, Stealth, and Swim checks increases to +6.
Swallow Whole: When the symbiant confirms a critical hit with its bite attack, or reduces a creature to 0 or fewer hit points with bite, it can attempt a grapple check with a +4 bonus against that creature as a free action. If it succeeds, the creature is swallowed whole. This functions against any creature up to one size larger than the symbiant. Only one creature can be swallowed whole in this way at a time. A conscious, swallowed creature keeps the grappled condition, while the symbiant does not. A swallowed creature can try to cut its way free with any light slashing or piercing weapon (the amount of cutting damage required to get free is equal to 1/10 of the symbiant’s total hit points), or it can just try to escape the grapple. The symbiant’s AC against such an attack is 10 + 1/2 its natural armor bonus, with no modifiers for size or Dexterity. If a swallowed creature cuts its way out, symbiant cannot use swallow whole again until the damage is healed. If the swallowed creature escapes the grapple, success puts it in the nearest free space adjacent to the symbiant, where it may be bitten or swallowed again. If no such space exists, it falls prone in the symbiant’s space.

At 20th level, a maturing symbiant grants its host the following benefits.

Nimble: The symbiant’s dodge bonus increases to +2.
Save Bonuses: The symbiant’s resistance bonus to saves increases to +4. This stacks with other resistance bonuses, but only up to +5 total.
Gnashing Bite: The symbiant’s bite attack gains the negating and speed weapon special abilities.
